decision.why: Confirm image coverage, song grouping and data integrity before choosing a small experiment. The seven-sample pilot cannot establish the required 32-sample completion.
decision.hypothesis: Dataset inspection will identify scope or image-quality constraints that affect feasible melody, chord and transposition experiments.
decision.expected_observation: A manifest summary with sample counts, grouping, available image artifacts and any integrity or readability issues.

observation.label_policy: Recognition sees images only. References are opened by evaluation.
observation.release_limits: Conservative completion guard for this prototype, not a musician-agreed product release threshold. A seven-sample pilot cannot complete this goal. Report measured improvements separately.
